SIM Swap Fraud and Phishing Incident Response

Document ID: SOP_C18_FRAUD_RESPONSE

Category: C18 — Security & Fraud

Department: Security

Customer Scope: all

Version: 1.0    Last Updated: 2026-08-08    Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base

Purpose

To enable rapid containment of suspected SIM swap fraud, phishing, or account takeover attempts.

Procedure

Verify caller identity via an independent channel (not the potentially compromised number).

Block the affected SIM immediately if fraud indicators are present, even before full verification completes, if risk is imminent.

Log the case as a P1 security incident.

Issue a verified replacement SIM only after standard KYC re-verification.

Notify the Security and Legal teams for cases involving confirmed financial loss for potential law-enforcement liaison.
